CLI structured-output envelope (#117 WS1). src/utils/output.ts holds module-global request-scoped state (json flag, command, result, warnings, error); CLI is single-threaded per process so module scope is safe. SINGLE EMIT POINT is withCliInstrumentation (utils/instrumentation.ts): in JSON mode it sinks handler stdout into the byte-counter (does NOT forward to real stdout) so stray console.log can't corrupt the envelope, then emits one envelope via the original stdout writer in its finally. Commands NOT wrapped (stats, audit, info, manifest, config meta) rely on the post-parseAsync finalize fallback in index.ts (emitEnvelope if isJsonMode && !alreadyEmitted) — that's why index.ts uses parseAsync not parse. Commands gate JSON output on isJsonMode() (global state set by the preAction hook from --json/RVR_OUTPUT), NOT on local options.json — the local flag only feeds the hook via optsWithGlobals(). printError(msg, code?)/printWarning/handleError are JSON-aware. Contract (pinned by docs/design-117-cli-agent-parity.md): reverie:"1" (string), error.code reuses MCP names with NO E_ prefix (renaming bumps ENVELOPE_VERSION), warnings as {code,message,count?} objects, confirm preview in error.preview. D3: --json reads moved bare→result (documented break).

RESULT POPULATION (#120, changed from per-site setResult discipline): for INSTRUMENTED commands the wrapper derives the envelope result from the handler's RETURN VALUE (when success, no error recorded, return value !== undefined, and no explicit setResult). New wrapped commands should just `return` their payload — unconditional console.log for humans is fine (sunk in JSON mode). Explicit setResult still WINS and is required when the result shape differs from the return value (searchEntries returns {dataCount,aliasCount} to the wrapper for hit detection but setResults {entries,aliases}) or when a result must accompany an error (failJson). withPager is generic and passes return values through — don't let a paged closure swallow them.

REMAINING GOTCHA — NOT-instrumented commands (finalize fallback): stdout is NOT sunk, so any console.log BEFORE an isJsonMode() early-return POLLUTES stdout alongside the envelope. Must branch `if (isJsonMode()){ setResult(...); return; }` before any human output, OR refuse (audit --follow refuses with INVALID_INPUT because an unbounded stream can't be one envelope). GUARD: cli-json-envelope.test.ts sweeps ~19 commands asserting every ok envelope has a result and stdout parses as exactly one JSON doc — extend the list when adding a command. The sweep caught data export shipping result-less on day one.

Also: advertised error codes must be PRODUCED, not just listed — printError defaults to RUNTIME, so encryption/decrypt/missing-value sites must pass explicit codes (ENCRYPTED_NO_PASSWORD/DECRYPT_FAILED/INPUT_REQUIRED) or agents branching on them never match. The error-code list in CLI_LLM_INSTRUCTIONS and AGENTS_MD_TEMPLATE interpolates ERROR_CODES from output.ts so prose can't drift. run --json must check proc.error from spawnSync (status AND signal null on spawn failure → would resolve to exitCode 0 / ok:true).
